question: What is the relative molecular mass of water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18 u**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Relative molecular mass of water (H₂O) is 18.
 
• The relative molecular mass is unit-le
